ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two horizontal straight lines, labeled y and z respectively, and both have the same double-arrow markings on their right sides, indicating y ∥ z. The oblique straight line x intersects both y and z. At the intersection of x and the upper straight line y, ∠8 is located below straight line y and to the right of straight line x; at the intersection of x and the lower straight line z, ∠12 is located above straight line z and to the right of straight line x. Reasoning: Because y ∥ z, and x is a transversal, ∠8 and ∠12 are same-side interior angles, and the two are supplementary. Given m∠12 = 64, therefore m∠8 = 180 - 64 = 116.

raw_record.question_text: In the figure, $m \angle 12 = 64$. Find the measure of $\angle 8$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the two horizontal lines labeled y and z have matching double arrow markings, so y ∥ z. The slanted line x intersects both of them; angle 8 is the interior angle below y on the right side of x, and angle 12 is the interior angle above z on the right side of x. From the text, m∠12 = 64 and the target is m∠8. Use the consecutive/same-side interior angle rule for parallel lines cut by transversal x: ∠8 and ∠12 are supplementary. Therefore m∠8 = 180 − 64 = 116.
